import inspect

import solution
from solution import fourth_Power_Sum


def test_issue_example_n2():
    """Example asserts fourth_Power_Sum(2) == 17."""
    assert fourth_Power_Sum(2) == 17  # 1^4 + 2^4 = 1 + 16


def test_issue_n1():
    """Sum of fourth power of first 1 natural number is 1."""
    assert fourth_Power_Sum(1) == 1  # 1^4 = 1


def test_issue_n3():
    """Sum of fourth power of first 3 natural numbers is 98."""
    assert fourth_Power_Sum(3) == 98  # 1 + 16 + 81


def test_issue_n4():
    """Sum of fourth power of first 4 natural numbers is 354."""
    assert fourth_Power_Sum(4) == 354  # 1 + 16 + 81 + 256


def test_issue_n5():
    """Sum of fourth power of first 5 natural numbers is 979."""
    assert fourth_Power_Sum(5) == 979  # 1 + 16 + 81 + 256 + 625


def test_issue_n6():
    """Sum of fourth power of first 6 natural numbers is 2275."""
    assert fourth_Power_Sum(6) == 2275  # 979 + 1296


def test_issue_n10():
    """Sum of fourth power of first 10 natural numbers is 25333."""
    assert fourth_Power_Sum(10) == 25333  # 15333 + 10000


def test_issue_n100():
    """Sum of fourth power of first 100 natural numbers is 2050333330."""
    assert fourth_Power_Sum(100) == 2050333330  # formula 100*101*201*30299/30


def test_issue_n0_empty():
    """Sum of fourth power of 0 natural numbers is 0."""
    assert fourth_Power_Sum(0) == 0  # empty sum = 0


def test_contract_exposed_in_solution():
    """Public interface exposes fourth_Power_Sum in module solution."""
    assert hasattr(solution, "fourth_Power_Sum")


def test_contract_callable():
    """Public interface defines fourth_Power_Sum as a callable function."""
    assert callable(fourth_Power_Sum)


def test_contract_single_parameter_n():
    """Public interface defines fourth_Power_Sum(n) with one parameter."""
    assert len(inspect.signature(fourth_Power_Sum).parameters) == 1
